contact_force_analysis.force_scope: Per-foot measured ground-normal force; whole-body external resultant reconstructed from mass-weighted COM momentum change minus gravity across the final physics step. Resultant valid only without other-body contact; no per-foot tangential force, yaw moment or cancellation measurement is available.
contact_force_analysis.point_scope: Estimated capsule-lowest point. Native COM linear velocity plus angular velocity crossed with the COM-to-point lever; installed Gym COM convention verified using an isolated off-center rigid body. Includes rolling; no world-position finite difference at large environment offsets. Not the velocity of the moving geometric minimum or a resolved solver contact patch.
contact_force_analysis.cost_scope: Bounded negative-only cost for resultant force opposite pre-action horizontal velocity correction; correct braking and vertical support exempt. Separate load-weighted material-point sliding cost. Per-foot cancellation disabled(weight0); useful yaw couples are not treated as cancellation.
contact_force_analysis.scope: Original episodes including startup and terminal samples. Fixed first environment per displayed scenario; no successful-episode selection. Last-physics-step endpoint samples at50Hz, not control-period mean or exact solver work. No policy update or task acceptance implied.

results/cmd16_hist6/contact_force_probe_.scope: Two56env force diagnostics differ only in point-velocity reconstruction, no policy update. Historical formal report used96simulation environments and is not trajectory-identical.
